question: As per Economic Survey Report 2022, ________ emerged as the leading state with Rs. 1,02,866 crore FDI inflow in 2021-22.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Karnataka.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **FDI (Foreign Direct Investment)** is an investment made by a company or an individual in one country into a business located in another country.
 
• The** Economic Survey Report 2022** provides an overview of the** Indian economy **and its performance over the past year.
 
• **Karnataka** has emerged as the leading state in terms of FDI inflow with an amount of **Rs. 1,02,866 crore in 2021-22, **which is a significant increase from the previous year.
 
• The state has been attracting FDI across various sectors such as **Information Technology, Biotechnology, Aerospace, Automotive, and Textiles.**
 
• The Karnataka government has been taking various initiatives to promote investment in the state, such as setting up a **single-window clearance** system and providing incentives to investors.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gujarat** is one of the leading states in terms of FDI inflow and has been attracting investments across various sectors such as **Chemicals, Petrochemicals, Pharmaceuticals, and Textiles.**
 
• **Uttar Pradesh** has been focusing on attracting investment in the** Infrastructure, Manufacturing, and Tourism** sectors and has been taking various initiatives to promote investment in the state.
 
• **Tamil Nadu** has been attracting investment in the **Automotive, Electronics, and Textiles sectors** and has been taking various initiatives to promote investment in the state.
 
• It is important to note that FDI inflow is not the only indicator of** economic growth and development,** and other factors such as **GDP, employment, and social indicators **should also be considered to assess the overall performance of a state or a country.
